# Subway Seat for btop

Every graph runs the 70s stripe, avocado to gold to orange to red, and the four boxes are outlined in orange, gold, avocado and terracotta.

[btop](https://github.com/aristocratos/btop) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/btop/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.theme`](subway-seat.theme) | ~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat.theme |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.theme`](subway-seat-tunnel.theme) | ~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.theme |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.theme`](subway-seat-enamel.theme) | ~/.config/btop/themes/subway-seat-enamel.theme |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf:

```conf
color_theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf:

```conf
color_theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/btop/btop.conf:

```conf
color_theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
